name: ba&sh
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $248 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's dresses, blouses, knitwear, coats, shoes and bags from a Paris label, dresses around $300–450 and coats $500–900, sold mainly through its own stores and site.
origin: Founded in 2003 by Barbara Boccara; Sharon Krief.

ownership.owner: ba&sh (founders hold the majority; HLD Group a shareholder)

quote.q: It is easy to recognize a ba&sh dress… The key? The happiness of the woman wearing it.

opview: “It is easy to recognize a ba&sh dress… The key? The happiness of the woman wearing it.” — ba&sh (house), Barbara & Sharon page, ba-sh.com

doors.note: 25 US rows: 10 own doors + 15 ba&sh shops inside Bloomingdale's (own name, phone and hours on the locator) filed as concessions. Locator omits state; state derived from ZIP. Site is ba-sh.com (us.ba-sh.com does not resolve).

craft_evidence.reasoning: Nearly every product page states a country of manufacture (76 of 80), spread across China, India, Turkey, Portugal and North Africa, but no maker, mill or owned facility is named anywhere read. A country on the label and little else is a 2.
